theorems.name: Submission.aetp_approxTangent_ae_of_inter
theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (A N : Set (Amb n ℓ)) (P : Amb n ℓ → Submodule ℝ (Amb n ℓ)), MeasurableSet A → MeasurableSet N → (μHE[n] : Measure (Amb n ℓ)) A < ⊤ → (μHE[n] : Measure (Amb n ℓ)) N < ⊤ → (∀ x ∈ N, Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter03.HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n N x (P x)) → ∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n] : Measure (Amb n ℓ)).restrict (A ∩ N), Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter03.HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n A x (P x)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
